content: I've already set the YOLO workspace to F:\python\yolov12-main. Please use scan_yolo_project("F:\python\yolov12-main") to explore the project structure, then look for yolov12n.yaml (it may be in a subdirectory like models/ or cfg/). Read the yaml file and explain the YOLOv12 architecture structure. Do NOT use direct file reading on the raw path - use the YOLO workspace tools instead.
